$comment: Grandfathered accepted/implemented RFCs whose primary normative artifact is not yet folded into the canonical spec (issue #204). Each MUST cite a follow-up issue tracking the fold. Remove an entry once its follow-up lands and the RFC's manifest fully resolves.
